run_metadata.coverage_summary: Commonwealth AusTender was the best-covered tier this run: multiple current approach-to-market notices were read (via the WebSearch summariser, since direct WebFetch was egress-blocked) and six open opportunities were captured with headline detail. NSW (buy.nsw / NSW eTendering) was partially covered. State portals (VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT) and VendorPanel were confirmed live and enumerated as sources but could not be directly queried for their live opportunity lists. Tier 3 corporate channels (SAP Ariba Discovery, EstimateOne) were checked and confirmed as registration/login-gated with no publicly visible opportunity captured.
gaps: MAJOR CONSTRAINT: the environment's network egress proxy blocked WebFetch to ALL external domains this run (EGRESS_BLOCKED on tenders.gov.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au, dfat.gov.au, vendorpanel.com.au and every other host tested). All tender data was therefore gathered indirectly through the WebSearch tool's page summariser; no detail page or tender document could be opened directly.

Because detail pages/documents could not be opened, no deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria/document-list extraction was possible. Every captured tender is headline-level only (see entries_pending_detail) and its description is derived from the AusTender listing text surfaced by search.

State portals VIC (tenders.vic.gov.au / buyingfor.vic.gov.au), WA (tenders.wa.gov.au), SA (tenders.sa.gov.au), TAS (tenders.tas.gov.au), ACT (tenders.act.gov.au), NT QTOL (tendersonline.nt.gov.au) and QLD (qtenders / supply.qld.gov.au) were confirmed reachable-by-name but their live open-tender lists were not retrievable via search snippets; no individual state opportunities were confidently captured this run and are deferred.

One NT opportunity (Department of Logistics and Infrastructure, closing 27-Aug-2026 2:00 PM ACST) was seen in a search snippet but its title and tender ID were not resolvable, so it was NOT recorded as a tender.

Tier 3 (private sector) MANDATORY check: SAP Ariba Discovery and EstimateOne were queried; both require supplier registration/login to view opportunity detail. No publicly visible corporate RFx could be captured without an authenticated session, so none were invented. The portals remain recorded in discovered_sources.
VendorPanel Public Tenders (public council opportunities) could not be read this run (egress-blocked host and no useful search snippet).
recommended_seed_additions: AusTender Supplier Portal (suppliers.tenders.gov.au) — Phase 3 opens registration to all suppliers from 1 July 2026; worth tracking as a buyer-search channel.
buy.nsw Supplier Hub (suppliers.buy.nsw.gov.au) — supplier-facing opportunity search subdomain of buy.nsw.

Note for future runs: this routine needs WebFetch (or an authenticated fetch path) unblocked for *.gov.au and vendorpanel.com.au to do real deliverables/document extraction; under egress-blocked conditions coverage is limited to search-surfaced headlines.

tenders.title: Provision of a National Government-contracted Doctor (GCD) network for Disability Support Pension medical assessments
tenders.category: Individual health screening and assessment services
tenders.description: Services Australia is seeking the provision of a National Government-contracted Doctor (GCD) network to deliver medical assessments for Disability Support Pension (DSP) customers.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Supply of a national network of contracted doctors able to perform individual health screening and assessment (medical assessments) supporting Disability Support Pension eligibility decisions. Full deliverable/requirement detail was not extractable because the tender detail page and documents could not be opened this run.
tenders.reasoning: Found via AusTender current ATM list (buyer-originated Commonwealth portal), surfaced through WebSearch because direct WebFetch was egress-blocked.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only; closes today (14-Aug-2026). Deliverables, requirements, value and contacts not captured because the detail page/documents were unreachable (egress block).

tenders.title: Provision of licensed GNSS CORS data streams, metadata and support services for the National Positioning Infrastructure Capability (NPIC)
tenders.description: Geoscience Australia is seeking licensed Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) Continuously Operating Reference Station (CORS) data streams, associated metadata and related support services for integration into the National Positioning Infrastructure Capability (NPIC), to enhance positioning performance, availability, resilience and coverage in identified Priority Positioning Areas across Australia.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Provision of access to existing third-party GNSS CORS infrastructure: licensed real-time/near-real-time data streams, associated station metadata, and related support services, integrated into the NPIC to improve positioning coverage and resilience in Priority Positioning Areas. Detailed deliverable list, requirements and evaluation criteria were not extractable this run (detail page/documents unreachable).
tenders.reasoning: Found via AusTender current ATM list (Geoscience Australia buyer profile), read through WebSearch summariser due to WebFetch egress block.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only. Publish date, value, contract term and documents not captured (detail page unreachable).

tenders.title: Panel for charter vessel services to combat and deter illegal foreign fishing
tenders.description: AFMA is seeking to establish a panel of service providers to supply a broad range of charter vessel services to combat and deter illegal foreign fishing around Australia and its external territories, and on the high seas where Australia has an interest.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Establishment of a multi-provider panel supplying charter vessel services including fisheries patrols, land-based disposal support, and disposal at sea, in support of AFMA's illegal-foreign-fishing deterrence operations. Detailed scope, requirements and evaluation criteria were not extractable this run (documents unreachable).
tenders.delivery_location: Australia, external territories and high seas
tenders.reasoning: Found via AusTender current ATM list (AFMA buyer profile), read through WebSearch summariser due to WebFetch egress block.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only; a panel establishment. Value, term and documents not captured (detail page unreachable).

tenders.title: Operational Energy Transitions Defence Research Centre (OET DRC)
tenders.buyer: Department of Defence - Defence Science and Research Group (DSRG)
tenders.description: Defence is establishing an Operational Energy Transitions Defence Research Centre (OET DRC) to conduct research contributing to the Defence Future Energy Strategy. The process involves selecting a lead partner and commencing research projects aligned to Defence's operational energy transition challenges.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Selection of a lead research partner to stand up and operate the OET Defence Research Centre and to select and commence research projects aligned to Defence's operational energy transition challenges, in support of the Defence Future Energy Strategy. Detailed deliverables, eligibility and evaluation criteria were not extractable this run (documents unreachable).
key_deliverables: Selection and commencement of aligned research projects
tenders.reasoning: Found via AusTender current ATM list (Department of Defence DSRG buyer profile), read through WebSearch summariser due to WebFetch egress block.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only. Value, term, eligibility and documents not captured (detail page unreachable).

tenders.title: Program 3 - Integrated disease management of Ascochyta blight and Botrytis grey mould in chickpea, lentil and faba bean
tenders.description: GRDC is seeking research services for integrated disease management of Ascochyta blight and Botrytis grey mould in chickpea, lentil and faba bean crops (part of a multi-program research investment).
tenders.deliverables_summary: Delivery of applied agricultural research to develop and validate integrated disease management approaches for Ascochyta blight and Botrytis grey mould across chickpea, lentil and faba bean. Detailed milestones, requirements and evaluation criteria were not extractable this run (documents unreachable).
tenders.reasoning: Found via AusTender current ATM list (GRDC buyer profile), read through WebSearch summariser due to WebFetch egress block.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only; closes today (14-Aug-2026). One of several linked GRDC research programs (PROC-9177422/24/25). Value and documents not captured (detail page unreachable).

tenders.title: Supply, Install and Service of Blasting and Vacuuming Equipment at Sydney Harbour Bridge
tenders.description: A NSW Transport Infrastructure Projects request for the supply, installation and servicing of blasting and vacuuming equipment used in maintenance works at the Sydney Harbour Bridge.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Supply, installation and ongoing servicing of blasting and vacuuming equipment supporting Sydney Harbour Bridge maintenance operations. Detailed scope, requirements and documents were not extractable this run (detail page unreachable and tender ID not confirmed).
tenders.reasoning: Surfaced from a buy.nsw opportunity-search result (buyer-originated NSW state portal) via WebSearch; direct portal access was egress-blocked.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only. Tender ID and exact closing time NOT confirmed and require verification; buyer division attributed as Transport Infrastructure Projects from the search snippet. Included with caution and marked pending detail.
